question: Do you have any plans to re-sell the short stories that have not been included in the Art Book’s special books?
answer: The shop specials are usually sold as extra books in Otsuka sensei’s Art Books, so I think it will stay in the same format. I personally don’t want to take any money for these shop specials, and since they’re a special pamphlet buyers receive if they go to the store with their own legs, personally, I am not planning to make them into actual books. I wanna see them as extra novels for the Art Books. However, I also feel handy having all the extra novels in one book instead of going through a thousand pages, so please buy them!
